Căn hộ bàn giao thô bên trong: trần, sàn: Apartments are handed over as bare shell inside: ceilings, floors and walls left unfinished; the exterior, aluminum-glass doors and loggia (tiled floor, tempered glass railing) finished; fire-rated wooden main door; electrical, water and internet connection points provided; buyers install their own air conditioning. When signing the sale and purchase agreement, buyers can register for built-in finishing handover: about 10.1 million VND/m² for studios, 9.5 million VND/m² for 1BR/1BR+, 11 million VND/m² for 2BR/3BR (including VAT, provisionally calculated on net area). For example, for a 30 m² studio the finishing package is about 303 million VND (calculated by Hoang Hiep).
